title: Early Infantile Krabbe Disease Due To a Novel Compound Heterozygous Mutation in a Tunisian Family
abstract: Krabbe disease is a rare lysosomal storage illness caused by a mutation in the Galc gene. It characterized by severe neurological and metabolic disorders. The early infantile form is the most common. Regardless of the non-specific signs, diagnosis could be challenging. Over time, novel gene variants are uncovered.
